strings.Консорциум «ЭнергоЦОД» · платформа коопе: ЭнергоЦОД Consortium · cooperation platform for data center and energy center market participants · calculation figures are not an offer
strings.Вы видите все модули: каталог, заявки, п: You see all modules: catalog, deals, contractor pools, member registry and settlements. The “Assemble contractor pool” button in deals produces qualified contacts.
strings.Опишите потребность в заявке, изучите ка: Describe your need in a deal, review the catalog and build a preliminary project economy in the configurator. The platform will assemble the contractor pool.
strings.Витрина проектов с экономикой: смотрите: A showcase of projects with economics: browse deals in “Assembling team” status, verify models in the configurator, choose your entry stage.
strings.Разместите ваши участки в каталоге: запо: List your sites in the catalog: fill in the connection parameters, they are critical to the site score. Editing is available in the site card.
strings.Вам видны площадки и заявки с потребност: You see sites and deals that need grid connection. Get involved early: mark the available capacity of your substations in the site cards.
strings.Заявки с потребностью в подключении к ВО: Deals that need fiber connectivity and sites where connectivity is required: backbones, last mile, two independent inputs, dark fiber. Your profile is visible to customers when the contractor pool is assembled.
strings.Ваши типовые конфигурации энергоцентров: Your standard energy center configurations are visible to customers. For deals in “Assembling team” status you receive qualified contacts matching your profile.
strings.Проекты приходят с решённым энергоснабже: Projects arrive with power supply already resolved. Browse deals, verify economics in the configurator, define the energy-center/data-center interface in the technical solution.
strings.Ранний вход: заявки на стадии проектиров: Early entry: deals at the design stage where the IT fit-out requirements are being shaped. Your profile in the member registry is visible to customers.
strings.Готовые объекты под управление и поток к: Ready facilities to manage and a flow of colocation customers. The EAM monitoring module is added in the next stage (after the pilots).
strings.__catalog_note__: Interface: EN. Catalog content (sites, equipment, regulations, DC registry) is kept in Russian.
